description: A terminal workbench in pure Rust: shells, persistent sessions, SSH and coding agents (nightly)
notes: Nightly pre-release built from the main branch: expect rough edges. The rolling 'nightly' release tag replaces its assets every night, so the version string changes with each build.

The vendor's portable ZIP is used as-is: the bundled '.tty7-portable' marker keeps the profile inside the app directory, which Scoop persists in its own 'tty7-desktop-nightly' data folder, separate from the stable 'tty7-desktop' app.
The bundled 'tty7-updater.exe' is removed during install, so the app cannot update or replace itself; update with 'scoop update tty7-desktop-nightly'.
tty7 never adds a run-at-login entry: there is no autostart code path in the binary, and the Settings entry called 'Startup & restore' only controls session restore, not Windows startup.
Run 'tty7-nightly' for the CLI and 'tty7-app-nightly' for the GUI, so both channels can be installed side by side.
